## Finding: two missing direct answer guards

**C2 · Medium severity · High confidence**  
**Location:** `words\大切.md:9`

Current declaration:

```yaml
quiz_exclusions: [高い, かわいい, 重い]
```

The displayed **«важный»** also permits legitimate answers for existing **大きい** and **大きな**:

- For **大きい**, the complete additional Jisho/JMdict object independently retrieved during this review explicitly includes **“important, decisive, valuable”**. This corroborates the nonphysical significance already taught in its frozen source/context pair.
- For **大きな**, the frozen English body explicitly teaches **“abstract importance”**, preserved as **«значимость»** in `words\大きな.md:17`. The prenominal restriction does not make **«важный»** an incorrect answer.

Thus these cards can still present two defensible answers. The existing edges through **大変** provide no protection: exclusions are not transitive.

**Minimal suggested fix:** add only `大きい` and `大きな` to the new **大切** card’s exclusion list. Leave both accepted baseline files unchanged.

Additional primary evidence: [大きい selected object](https://jisho.org/api/v1/search/words?keyword=%E5%A4%A7%E3%81%8D%E3%81%84). The separate complete **大きな** object was also read; its concise “big/large/great” definitions were not falsely presented as explicitly saying “important.”

## Adjudication of the existing 49 proposals

I found all **49 defensible as direct answer-safety guards**, not assertions of unrestricted synonymy:

| Left endpoint | Retain direct guards |
|---|---|
| 上手 | 強い, いい, 良い |
| 下手 | 弱い, 悪い, 不味い |
| 好き | 大好き |
| 嫌 | 嫌い, 悪い, 不味い, うるさい |
| 楽しい | 面白い, いい, 良い, 明るい, 元気, 賑やか |
| つまらない | 寒い, 弱い, 悪い, 不味い |
| 困る | 苦しい |
| 大変 | 苦しい, 重い, 大切, 大きい, 大きな |
| 大切 | 高い, かわいい, 重い |
| 立派 | いい, 良い, きれい, 結構, 重い |
| 結構 | いい, 良い, 大丈夫, 組織, 楽しい |

| 便利 | いい, 良い |
| うるさい | 賑やか |
| 賑やか | 元気, 明るい |

The conservative proposals were individually considered: skill-related **«хороший»**; **«слабый/плохой/неудачный»** assessments of disappointing work; annoying **«неприятный»**; spirited **«весёлый»**; dignified **«достойный»**; delightful **«приятный»**; and dictionary-supported time off versus **休日**. These do not justify positive/negative category closure.

I did **not** unrestrictedly transfer 面白い’s usually-negative favourable sense, 苦しい’s suffix sense, or 良い’s easy-to suffix sense to bare roots.

## C1/C3 observations and limits

No actionable Japanese or Russian-prose defect was established. The retained corrections concerning **ず**, whole-word **へた**, チョロい, desire constructions, 結構’s noun sense, omitted-subject neutrality and workload versus liveliness are sound within the evidence read. Both HTML-recovery guidance lines are accurate and natural Russian.

The **39 required selected objects**, plus **two additional corroborating objects**, are not an all-homonyms review. External reading included the reached Japanese **じょうず** section, not the later incomplete **じょうしゅ** section; the returned Kotobank definition and NINJAL sections; and the complete recovered desire-section text.

No files were edited; no agents, builds, tests, validation reruns, commits or publication occurred. The author’s recorded checks were not independently rerun. App tag mappings, device/native behaviour, media pixels and full-corpus/release acceptance remain **UNVERIFIED**.
